tags.title: Tags
tags.help: Tags come from source text. Deleting one removes its current index association; parsing the document again can restore it.
tags.failed: Couldn't load or update tags. Try again.
tags.running: Parsing is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
tags.rankInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
tags.chooseDatasets: Choose up to 32 datasets you can access, then run the aggregation.
tags.confirmHelp: This removes current index associations. Parsing the documents again can restore these tags:

chunking.tagSettings: Adds weighted tags from the most frequent source terms in each chunk. Chunk size applies; delimiters and overlap do not. No model is used.
